observation.visible_scene: A young man with short hair, wearing a black shirt with pale vertical striped straps and a silver chain necklace, sits behind a drum kit lit in teal and magenta. A large cymbal occupies the right foreground, a snare drum is in front of him, and chrome drum hardware reflecting pink light is on the left. He holds a drumstick in each hand and is actively playing.
visible_changes: The drummer's right hand (viewer's left) continuously cycles the stick between a raised, near-vertical position and a lowered position over the snare, producing a repeated striking motion visible throughout the excerpt (e.g., vertical/blurred at frames 2-4, low at 5, raised again at 6-10, and so on).
Motion blur on the right-hand stick in several frames (2, 3, 16, 17, 28, 29) indicates fast up-and-down movement rather than a held pose.
The left hand (viewer's right) holds a stick near the cymbal with smaller vertical oscillations and occasional blur, consistent with continuous cymbal/hi-hat strokes.
The man's head and facial expression remain largely steady (eyes downcast/closed), with only minor sway accompanying the arm motion.
The drum kit, cymbal, and background shelving keep the same relative positions, indicating the playing motion is the dominant change rather than scene rearrangement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The musical tempo, beat pattern, and whether this excerpt begins or ends on a stroke are not determinable from the cropped segment.
The full extent of the drum kit and any foot-pedal action are outside the frame.
What precedes and follows this excerpt is unknown; the drumming is already ongoing at t=0 and continues at the last frame.
uncertain_details: The camera appears essentially static with only possible minor handheld jitter; the slight framing differences are too small to confirm deliberate movement.
Whether each left-hand oscillation corresponds to an actual cymbal contact cannot be confirmed from the stills.
